integrity_notes: Exact covariance-map determinant factorization checked symbolically by the included verification script.
The example's positive-root count is certified by Sturm's theorem; the decimal is only an approximation.
Literature overlap search is not a proof of exhaustive novelty; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two rank-one positive-semidefinite component Hessians in dimension two; nonparallel directions only.
Constant step size and independent uniform choice between the two epoch orders; no additive gradient noise or momentum.
The result identifies only the connected stable interval starting at zero, not all possible stable step-size intervals above the first boundary.
title: An exact mean-square stability frontier for two-component random reshuffling
